correctness.rationale: For m>=3, strict trace-inverse convexity and strict logdet concavity over the edge-injective weighted Laplacian prove uniqueness on the whole unconstrained edge allocation domain. Full class-group symmetry then proves x and y uniformity. The stated spectrum is derived exactly; boundary first derivatives give r_A and r_D and the positive rational difference. The critical-window limits follow from uniform-on-compact derivative expansions and derivative sign bracketing. Seven symbolic identity checks, 63 full matrix spectra, 63 support/budget checks, 1,890 asymmetric comparisons and 12 edgewise optimizations independently cross-check finite instances; the infinite proof is analytical.

value.rationale: An exact nonempty surcharge interval for every m>=3 separates the optimal supports of two standard mathematical network criteria. The asymptotically distinct m^{-1} deletion laws, with coefficients one and two, provide a structurally motivated design trade-off on a natural graph family rather than an isolated symbolic identity. The result specifies globally unique unrestricted conductance allocations and a reproducible implicit interior A prescription.
